review_method: Visual inspection of both saved error grids after the locked test evaluation. These are hypotheses, not causal attributions.

transfer.1: The painted face has saturated colours and glossy highlights; these may resemble generated portraits despite its Real folder label.
transfer.2: The bright red wig and highly colourful mural create an unusual photographic scene that may resemble synthetic imagery.
transfer.3: The AI-labelled mountain illustration resembles a conventional travel poster; the stock watermark and drawn textures may provide misleading familiar cues.
transfer.4: The close-up of a paint palette and brushes contains irregular colour patches and clutter that may be confused with generated textures.
transfer.5: The flat geometric mountain graphic resembles ordinary vector design, which also occurs among the Real class's non-photographic images.
transfer.6: The side-by-side segmentation map and realistic lake scene may let the photographic half or unusual composite layout dominate the decision.
transfer.7: Many small headshots are combined in a grid; resizing may remove facial detail, while the repeated portrait layout resembles synthetic face collections.
transfer.8: The sepia tiger-and-machinery illustration resembles traditional concept art, making artistic style an unreliable origin cue.
transfer.9: The mouths use flat pop-art colours and repeated outlines, which overlap with poster and illustration styles in the Real class.
transfer.10: The painted eye has strong brush textures and saturated colour blocks that may resemble generated artwork; painted style does not determine origin.

baseline.1: Saturated paint and glossy facial highlights may match coarse colour and texture patterns associated with AI examples.
baseline.2: The large flat sun and black silhouettes resemble a digital illustration, a style that overlaps with AI-labelled artwork.
baseline.3: The strongly saturated golden sunset may trigger a colour-based shortcut even though the dataset labels this scene Real.
baseline.4: The crowded, compressed group photograph contains many tiny faces and visible watermark text; downsampling can obscure natural photographic detail.
baseline.5: The generated subject is presented as a framed artwork on a gallery wall; the frame and surrounding room may supply convincing photographic context.
baseline.6: The pink and purple terraced landscape has a familiar field layout; a small CNN may miss the implausible colours and repeated terrain patterns.
baseline.7: The smooth white cartoon cat resembles conventional illustration, so stylization alone cannot distinguish AI generation from human-made artwork.
baseline.8: The hybrid animal has a natural-looking brown background and lighting; resizing may conceal the anatomical inconsistencies that could distinguish it.
baseline.9: The colourful profile is displayed like a physical art print, potentially making its presentation resemble Real artwork examples.
baseline.10: The geometric map graphic resembles conventional vector art; the CNN may learn broad subject/style cues rather than generation-specific evidence.
